headline: Faced with declining external aid, UEMOA and Abidjan activate levers of endogenous financing
summary: Public and financial decision-makers say reducing dependence on foreign capital is urgent, as external debt costs rise and international flows become more volatile. Mobilising domestic resources is presented as central to economic resilience.
why: The UEMOA is the West African Economic and Monetary Union, a currency and policy bloc whose members share the CFA franc. Shifts toward domestic financing affect sovereign borrowing and regional bond markets.
original_headline: Face au recul de l’aide extérieure, l’UEMOA et Abidjan activent les leviers du financement endogène
